list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM netmon.traffic_live WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY host

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(tcp_tx * scale) AS `TCP sent`, sum(tcp_rx * scale) AS `TCP received`,
  sum(udp_tx * scale) AS `UDP sent`, sum(udp_rx * scale) AS `UDP received`,
  sum(nfs_read * scale) AS `NFS read`, sum(nfs_write * scale) AS `NFS written`,
  sum(nfs_fetched * scale) AS `NFS fetched`, sum(nfs_sent * scale) AS `NFS sent`
FROM netmon.traffic_live WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Traffic netmon accounts for
panels.description: The bytes netmon charges to processes, as a share of what the host's interfaces moved less 66 bytes of headers a packet, per host and direction. Green: netmon accounts for it all. Red: traffic no process sent or received, such as ICMP, ARP, DHCP and TCP retransmissions. Over 100% shows as green: a VPN's bytes count inside and outside its tunnel.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  -- Whole 10 s reports per bucket, as in the rate panels.
  intDiv($__interval_s + 9, 10) * 10 AS step,
  -- Each packet's Ethernet, IP and TCP headers, which the interfaces count
  -- and processes' sends and receives don't: 14 + 20 + 32 bytes for IPv4 TCP
  -- with timestamps. A bare ACK is all headers.
  66 AS headers,
  processes AS (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(ts), toIntervalSecond(step)) AS time, host,
      sum((tcp_rx + udp_rx) * scale) AS rx, sum((tcp_tx + udp_tx) * scale) AS tx
    FROM netmon.traffic_live
    WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY time, host
  ),
  interfaces AS (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(ts), toIntervalSecond(step)) AS time, host,
      greatest(sum(rx_bytes) - headers * sum(rx_packets), 0) AS rx,
      greatest(sum(tx_bytes) - headers * sum(tx_packets), 0) AS tx
    FROM netmon.interfaces_live
    WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
      -- Bridges and veth pairs carry bytes that cross another interface too.
      AND NOT match(interface, '^(veth|docker|br-|virbr)')
    GROUP BY time, host
  )
SELECT time, concat(host, ' ', direction) AS row, accounted
FROM (
  SELECT i.time AS time, i.host AS host,
    arrayJoin([('received', p.rx / nullIf(i.rx, 0)), ('sent', p.tx / nullIf(i.tx, 0))])
      AS pair,
    pair.1 AS direction, pair.2 AS accounted
  FROM interfaces AS i LEFT JOIN processes AS p ON i.time = p.time AND i.host = p.host
)
ORDER BY time, row

WITH
  -- Whole 10 s reports per bucket, or a 15 s bucket swings by a third.
  intDiv($__interval_s + 9, 10) * 10 AS step,
  top AS (
  SELECT comm FROM netmon.traffic_live WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY comm ORDER BY sum((tcp_tx + tcp_rx + udp_tx + udp_rx) * scale) DESC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(ts), toIntervalSecond(step)) AS time, comm,
  sum((tcp_tx + tcp_rx + udp_tx + udp_rx) * scale) / step AS bytes_per_s
FROM netmon.traffic_live
WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND comm IN top
GROUP BY time, comm ORDER BY time

panels.description: File bytes the NFS server sent for each process's reads: page-cache misses, readahead, memory-mapped and O_DIRECT reads. NFS read counts file bytes, cached or not. Empty before netmon counted it.

WITH
  -- Whole 10 s reports per bucket, or a 15 s bucket swings by a third.
  intDiv($__interval_s + 9, 10) * 10 AS step,
  top AS (
  SELECT comm FROM netmon.traffic_live WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: File bytes the NFS server took for each process's writes, which the client sends later, from writeback, fsync() or close(): each charged to the last process to write that MiB of the file. NFS written counts file bytes as written. Empty before netmon counted it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  -- Whole 10 s reports per bucket, or a 15 s bucket swings by a third.
  intDiv($__interval_s + 9, 10) * 10 AS step,
  top AS (
  SELECT toString(uid) FROM netmon.traffic_live WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY toString(uid) ORDER BY sum((tcp_tx + tcp_rx + udp_tx + udp_rx) * scale) DESC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(ts), toIntervalSecond(step)) AS time, toString(uid),
  sum((tcp_tx + tcp_rx + udp_tx + udp_rx) * scale) / step AS bytes_per_s
FROM netmon.traffic_live
WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND toString(uid) IN top
GROUP BY time, toString(uid) ORDER BY time

SELECT host, comm, uniqExact(pid) AS pids,
  sum((tcp_tx + udp_tx) * scale) AS sent, sum((tcp_rx + udp_rx) * scale) AS received,
  sum(nfs_read * scale) AS nfs_read, sum(nfs_write * scale) AS nfs_written,
  sum(nfs_fetched * scale) AS nfs_fetched, sum(nfs_sent * scale) AS nfs_sent
FROM netmon.traffic_live WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY host, comm ORDER BY sent + received + greatest(nfs_read, ifNull(nfs_fetched, 0))
  + greatest(nfs_written, ifNull(nfs_sent, 0)) DESC LIMIT 50
